news.title: Daily pass: 513 verified additions (R3048–R3560)
news.detail: No leads were open at the start. Discovery added 513 verified sources for the next least-covered families — lightweight-aggregate concrete (perlite, EPS, plastic-waste aggregates), calcium sulfoaluminate and calcium aluminate cements, LC3/low-grade calcined clays, CO2-cured and magnesium (phosphate, oxysulfate, reactive MgO) binders, silica fume and nano-silica, GGBS/steel/copper slags, emerging SCMs (waste glass, biochar, sludge ash, marble/brick powders, gangue, phosphogypsum), blended cements, structural concrete (confinement, bond, shear, punching, creep/shrinkage models, precast), test methods and codes (ACI 318, Eurocode 2, ASTM C143) and cement-industry decarbonisation/recycled aggregates — plus 93 records from backward and 45 from forward citation chases, 44 non-English records (Czech, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Indonesian, Italian, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish; English glosses), Type IL legacy-topic backfill (mix, supply, international, applications, field, strength, durability), DOT/university reports and theses, CiNii Books catalogue records for classic textbooks, and a Nov 2026 current-awareness sweep (35 records dated 2026). 67 new leads were rejected as unverifiable; none left open. Mostly DOI/abstract-level, not full-text reviews.

change.entry: Daily pass 2026-11-19: 513 verified additions R3048–R3560 (all from new discovery: title.search backfill with period splits and page-2 re-queries, historical/government/standards searches, language-filtered searches, PLC legacy-topic backfill, current-awareness sweep, backward/forward citation chase from existing records in the focus topics and from the most-cited Nov 18 additions). 580 new leads checked: 513 promoted, 67 rejected as unverifiable, 0 left open. No corrections to existing records. R1–R3047 preserved (R428 still retired); topic membership union maintained.

gap: Daily pass 2026-11-19: additions are registry/catalogue-verified (143 abstract-level, 340 DOI metadata only, 22 landing pages read, 8 library catalogue records) — not full-text reviewed. Many Elsevier items have no abstract in Crossref/OpenAlex, so descriptions are bibliographic only. 28 of 95 no-DOI hits were inspectable and added (incl. 8 CiNii Books catalogue records); the other 67 were rejected as unverifiable and logged in the candidate queue (TRID timeouts, CiNii article/CNKI/CQVIP/ResearchGate pages, ROSA P/Theseus/yadda/DOAJ pages returning 403, JS-only repositories and PDFs) — e.g. Neville Properties of Concrete (4th ed.), PCA Design and Control of Concrete Mixtures, the Concrete Admixtures Handbook, the FHWA UHPC state-of-the-art report and several creep/shrinkage books remain gaps. Plain-http landing URLs failed from the box and were read over https. Two hits whose DOIs are unregistered (Russian MCE, Turkish Teknik Dergi) were added from their article pages with the DOI recorded as listedDoi. No open leads.

takeaways.concrete-lightweight: Nov 19 backfill (DOI/abstract level): expanded-perlite, EPS/polystyrene and PET/PVC-waste lightweight aggregate concretes (thermal conductivity, mechanical properties), fibre-reinforced high-strength lightweight concrete, the lightweight-aggregate interfacial zone (1990), stud connectors in lightweight concrete (1971), CO2 curing of lightweight blocks and 2026 lightweight-concrete studies (R3126–R3393, 20 records). Not full-text reviewed.
takeaways.binder-cac-csa: Nov 19 backfill: calcium sulfoaluminate (CSA) cement hydration, retarders, fly-ash and OPC blends, carbonation, carbon footprint of CSA clinker, ye'elimite-rich and belite-sulfoaluminate clinkers, CSA for 3D printing, ettringite formation/expansion and DEF, calcium aluminate cement hydration heat and castables, sulfo-/ferroaluminate cements in China and the 1909 lime–alumina–silica phase study (R3070–R3359, 25 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.binder-lc3: Nov 19 backfill: LC3 hydration and phase assemblage at <50 % clinker, low-grade/marine/illitic calcined clays, flash calcination, sulfate optimisation, shrinkage, chloride and carbonation modelling, LC3 in 3D printing and recycled-aggregate concrete, life-cycle cost of LC3 structures and 2023–2024 reviews (R3092–R3446, 25 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.binder-magnesium-carbonatable: Nov 19 backfill: CO2/accelerated carbonation curing (blocks, recycled aggregates, belite cements, 1974 calcium silicate mortars), reactive MgO LCA and MgO porous blocks, magnesium potassium phosphate cements (reaction, pore structure, fly ash), magnesium oxysulfate cement phases (R3116–R3510, 28 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.scm-silica: Nov 19 backfill: silica fume in high-strength, rubberised, fibre-reinforced and self-compacting concretes, heat of hydration and tensile strength, durability review (2011), nano-silica effects on setting, early strength, UHPC hydration and durability, colloidal nano-SiO2 (R3160–R3507, 31 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.scm-slag: Nov 19 backfill: GGBS dosage and hydraulic activity, GGBS–fly ash blends, slag chemistry and C-A-S-H in alkali-activated slag (1994–2011 classics), steel slag (clinker raw material, aggregate, blended cements, review), copper slag in mortar/concrete (R3104–R3530, 49 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.scm-emerging: Nov 19 backfill: waste glass (powder pozzolan, aggregate, sodium silicate activator; reviews 2009–2016), marble/granite powders, recycled concrete/brick powder, biochar in mortar and UHPC, sewage sludge ash, coal gangue, phosphogypsum, ceramic waste and 2026 mine-tailings cements (R3067–R3544, 46 records). DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.binder-blended: Nov 19 backfill: blended-cement hydration by calorimetry/TGA, fly ash fineness, sulfate attack on blended cements, hybrid alkali-activated fly ash–portland blends, brick-powder and POFA/RHA blends, low-heat low-carbon blended cements, Spanish pozzolanic-cement literature (1963) and 2026 tailings blends (R3050–R3546, 33 records). Many 'composite cement' hits were fibre composites and were re-tagged. DOI/abstract level only.
takeaways.concrete-structural: Nov 19 backfill: confined-concrete stress–strain models (Mander 1988, Sheikh, spiral confinement), bond and slip of deformed bars, shear transfer and modified compression field, punching shear of slabs, creep/shrinkage models (B3, microprestress, age-adjusted modulus), precast seismic systems (PRESSS), concrete-filled steel tubes, FRP bars and confinement (R3140–R3555, 61 records). Seismic code-comparison and fragility papers left out.
takeaways.cross-tests-codes: Nov 19 backfill: ACI 318-14/318-19 code records, Eurocode 2 designers' guide, ASTM C143 slump, the BSI cube-strength test method (1983), mini-slump and yield-stress cone tests, specimen size/shape effects, water/chloride permeability of cracked concrete, freeze–thaw testing, electrical conduction (1981) and non-English test-method literature (R3085–R3552, 33 records). Catalogue/DOI level; normative text not reviewed.
takeaways.cross-environment-cost: Nov 19 backfill: cement-industry CO2 abatement and decarbonisation reviews, eco-efficient cements, EU ETS leakage, energy/emission reduction opportunities (OSTI report, 2003), recycled concrete aggregate durability and specifications (Materials and Structures, 1994), carbonation uptake in life cycle, life-cycle cost of marine RC structures, geopolymer cost/carbon comparison (R3064–R3557, 72 records). DOI/abstract level only.
